metadata.method_name: SAM vs SGD: calibration after temperature scaling (Fashion-MNIST, small CNN)
metadata.description: Matched gradient budget comparison. B (SAM, N epochs, two gradient evaluations per step) is compared with C (SGD, 2N epochs) in the primary contrast and with A (SGD, N epochs) in the matched-epochs contrast. Metrics on the 10,000-image official test split; temperature fitted on the 5,000-image validation split.

conditions.B: SAM, N epochs, rho*, lr_sam (main SAM arm, 2 gradient evaluations per step)
conditions.C: SGD, 2N epochs (matched gradient-budget control, main comparison)

config.scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR, T_max = epochs * steps_per_epoch, stepped every iteration
config.augmentation: random crop, 2-pixel zero padding in pixel space, per-sample offsets, no flips

deviations: Hidden layer of the classifier head has 64 units (about 0.22M parameters), not the 128 in the direction (about 0.42M), to stay in the stated 0.1-0.3M range.
Learning rate and rho tuned at N epochs and reused for the 2N-epoch control C. C uses the SGD learning rate selected at N.
BatchNorm running statistics are updated on both forward passes of each SAM step (PyTorch default).
Bootstrap intervals capture test-sampling noise only; decisions also use the seed-level paired differences.
Corrupted-test logits are saved in reserved/corruptions and no metric is computed on them in this iteration.
The optional Gauss-Newton sharpness check is not part of this artifact.

tuning.selection_rule: lowest validation NLL of the uncalibrated model

examples.input: Fashion-MNIST official test image 0; classify into 10 clothing classes.
